newsitem.title: USA: Fremont, Kerr extend offer for Kerr Group.
newsitem.headline: Fremont, Kerr extend offer for Kerr Group.

text.p: Fremont Acquisition Co and Kerr Acquisition Corp said Tuesday they had extended through August 11 their tender offer for all outstanding common and preferred stock of Kerr Group Inc.

As of 1700 EDT August 4, 67 percent of the common stock on a converted, fully diluted basis had been tendered. Overall, 3,097,682 shares of common stock and 212,894 shares of preferred had been tendered, representing 79 percent of the common and 44 percent of the preferred outstanding, it said.
Kerr Group, headquartered in Lancaster, Pa., is a major producer of plastic packaging products.
